features.name: Project Setup
features.description: Initialize the project structure and development environment
acceptanceCriteria: Project directory structure is created
Dependencies are installed
Development server starts without errors

features.name: Hello World Endpoint
features.description: Create a basic health-check or hello-world API endpoint
acceptanceCriteria: Endpoint responds with HTTP 200
Response body contains expected message

features.name: Basic Authentication
features.description: Implement user login and logout functionality
acceptanceCriteria: User can log in with valid credentials
Invalid credentials return an error
Authenticated session is maintained

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Allow new users to create accounts
acceptanceCriteria: Registration form validates required fields
Duplicate emails are rejected
New user is persisted to the database

features.name: Data Persistence
features.description: Connect the application to a persistent data store
acceptanceCriteria: Application connects to the database on startup
Data survives a server restart

features.name: Input Validation
features.description: Validate and sanitize all user-supplied inputs
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid input returns a descriptive error message
SQL injection and XSS inputs are rejected or escaped

features.name: Error Handling
features.description: Return structured error responses for all failure cases
acceptanceCriteria: Errors include a human-readable message
HTTP status codes are appropriate (4xx for client, 5xx for server)

features.name: Logging
acceptanceCriteria: Errors are logged with stack traces
Request/response cycles are logged at info level

features.name: Configuration Management
features.description: Support environment-specific configuration via environment variables
acceptanceCriteria: Application reads config from environment variables
Missing required config fails fast with a clear message

features.name: Basic UI Layout
features.description: Create the main application layout with navigation
acceptanceCriteria: Layout renders without errors
Navigation links are visible and functional
Layout is responsive on mobile and desktop

features.name: List View
features.description: Display a paginated list of main resource items
acceptanceCriteria: List renders items from the data source
Empty state is shown when no items exist
Pagination controls appear when items exceed page size

features.name: Detail View
features.description: Show full details for a single resource item
acceptanceCriteria: Detail page loads from item ID in URL
404 page shown for unknown IDs

features.name: Create Form
features.description: Form to create a new resource item
acceptanceCriteria: Form validates required fields before submit
Successful submission redirects to the new item
Server-side errors are displayed inline

features.name: Edit Form
features.description: Form to update an existing resource item
acceptanceCriteria: Form pre-fills current values
Changes are persisted on submit

features.name: Delete Action
features.description: Allow users to delete a resource item
acceptanceCriteria: User is prompted to confirm before deletion
Item is removed from the data store after confirmation
